body:
No current tolerance to any of the substances mentioned
0:00 or 10:40PM EST: Ingested 2.5mgs etizolam liquid solution, 20mgs U4770 liquid solution, and 150mgs of quetiapine pill form in hopes of a quick sleep solution.
0:10  beginning to feel a little tired, sitting on my bed documenting how I feel, petting my dog, she feels extra soft, Im getting the impression she is going to steal the pillows again
0:15  got headphones listening to I am a Nightmare by Brand New, sounds better than when I listened to it earlier
0:20  feeling more tired, but still comprehending things, reading a subreddit, want a cigarette but, cant sneak out, injured and such, would wake my parents, not trying to deal with that right now
0:25  re-listening to I am a Nightmare by Brand New, sounds better with each listen, going to research etizolam a bit,
0:30 - beginning to zone out harder, prob could sleep if I wanted to, want to fight it for another 15 mins, but that may not be wise, in case of blackout
0:35  listening to Mene by brand new, very pleasurable, going to sleep, getting hit hard by etizolam and seroquel
